explanation: Both partners carry a change in NAGA, linked to Schindler disease (autosomal recessive). A child who inherits the change of each parent can have the condition: 1 in 2 per pregnancy. B has two changes in the gene; when they sit on different copies, every child gets one, and the chance is higher.
